one_liner: Create and manage ads that reach users looking for your products or services on Google Search, Display, YouTube and more.

auth.notes: OAuth 2.0 is the authentication protocol. A developer token is also required for API calls but functions as a configuration credential, not an authentication scheme. Pages do not specify OAuth grant types (authorization_code, service_account, etc.)

evidence.snippet: Google Ads API utilizes the OAuth 2.0 protocol for authentication and authorization
In addition to OAuth 2.0 credentials, a developer token is also required to make Google Ads API calls.

access.notes: Test access is free and self-serve; developers can create a Google Cloud project and enable the API. Production account access requires application review and approval for Explorer, Basic, or Standard access levels. Review is automated in most cases.

evidence.snippet: Explorer access (automated review and approval in most cases, for up to 2,880 operations per day on production accounts)
Basic access applications are automated and will be reviewed within minutes after brand verification

api_surface.rate_limit_note: Mutate requests limited to 10,000 operations per request; planning services 1-2 QPS per customer; conversion upload 2,000 per request.

evidence.snippet: Google Ads API calls can be made using either gRPC (preferred) or REST.
Mutate requests are limited to 10,000 operations per request, in addition to counting against the daily operation quota.
